replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
content=Knights.esp
start=ImperialDungeon01::ref=0x1fc41::side=south
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[Models]
load unsupported nif files = true
[Shaders]
force shaders = true
[Sound]
master volume = 1.0
music volume = 0.4
sfx volume = 1.0
voice volume = 1.0
[General]
screenshot format = png
[Physics]
oblivion fixed substep = 0.0167
